title: The Dino Trail
blurb: Finn and Zeb go back in time to find out if dino mums stayed with their babies.
cover_prompt: Finn and Zeb stand heroically in front of a glowing round time gate on a prehistoric plain with giant ferns and a smoking volcano, a gentle duck-billed Maiasaura dinosaur mother and her tiny babies beside them, big three-toed footprints in the mud leading forward.

sound.label: /ai/
sound.intro: Listen for the /ai/ sound, as in wait. In this story it is spelt three ways. Tap a word to hear it.

cracked: Dino mums stayed with their babies and brought them food. Finn and Zeb cracked the case!

text: Finn and Zeb are in the Den. Ping!
A new case! Finn grabs the case file.
p1.prompt: Inside a cosy explorer den full of maps, fossils and a glowing wall screen, Finn grabs a bright orange folder from a desk while Zeb bounces beside a big screen that shows a dinosaur footprint and a flashing alert light.

text: Did dino mums stay with their babies?
Nobody can say. Time to go and see!
p2.prompt: Finn and Zeb look up at a big wall screen in their explorer den showing a cartoon duck-billed dinosaur next to a nest of eggs and a large question mark; Finn points at the screen with a pencil, Zeb scratches his head, thinking.

text: They put on the time packs and step
into the Time Gate. It shakes! It shines!
p3.prompt: Finn and Zeb, wearing small silver backpacks with glowing blue dials, step hand in hand into a huge round shimmering time gate that glows blue, orange and white, sparks and swirls around them, inside a workshop.

text: It is hot and wet. Giant ferns sway.
A big footprint! Zeb can fit inside it.
p4.prompt: A steamy prehistoric swamp with giant ferns and a far-off smoking volcano. Zeb stands inside one enormous three-toed dinosaur footprint pressed into the mud, arms out in delight, while Finn kneels beside it with a notebook, amazed.

text: The footprints go two ways.
Which way, Finn?

options.label: Up the hill to the cave

c1.prompt: A muddy prehistoric clearing where a line of big three-toed dinosaur footprints splits in two: one trail climbs a green hill towards a dark cave mouth, the other runs down to a wide blue lake. Finn and Zeb stand at the fork, Finn scratching his chin, Zeb pointing both ways at once.

text: The cave is dark and damp. Drip, drip.
A snail! Just a snail, says Finn.
b1a.prompt: Inside a dark dripping cave lit by Finn's torch beam, Finn and Zeb peer at a huge friendly snail the size of a football on a wet rock. Zeb has jumped back in surprise, Finn is laughing.

text: From the cave they can see a wide plain.
Big bumps in rows. Nests! They race down.
b1a2.prompt: Finn and Zeb stand at a cave mouth high on a hill looking out over a wide sunny plain dotted with rows of big round mud nests, each with a duck-billed dinosaur beside it; the boys are starting to run down the slope, excited.

text: At the lake, the mud is deep and grey.
Zeb gets stuck! Finn pulls him free.
b1b.prompt: At the edge of a prehistoric lake with dragonflies, Zeb is stuck up to his knees in grey mud, laughing, while Finn tugs his arms to pull him out. Reeds and ferns all around, pterosaurs far in the sky.

text: A line of dinos plods past. A herd!
Finn and Zeb trail them to the nests.
b1b2.prompt: Finn and Zeb crouch in tall reeds watching a herd of gentle duck-billed Maiasaura dinosaurs plod past in a line along a lake shore towards a plain of nests, warm evening light, the boys following quietly behind.

text: In one nest, ten tiny babies wait.
Each one is as long as a cat.
p5.prompt: Close view of a big round mud nest holding ten tiny baby duck-billed dinosaurs, each about the size of a cat, with big eyes and wobbly legs, peeping up. Finn and Zeb lie on their tummies at the rim of the nest, gazing in with delight.

text: The babies peep and wave their tails.
But no mum can be seen. Is she late?
p6.prompt: Finn and Zeb stand beside a mud nest of baby duck-billed dinosaurs that wave their little tails and peep; Finn shades his eyes looking across the empty plain, Zeb looks worried, a few raindrops starting to fall from grey clouds.

text: Then the ground shakes. Thud! Thud!
A huge dino comes up the trail. The mum!
p7.prompt: A huge gentle duck-billed Maiasaura dinosaur mother, as long as a bus, walks up a trail towards her nest with a mouthful of green plants; Finn and Zeb hold on to each other as the ground shakes, their faces full of awe, not fear.

text: Her mouth is like a duck's bill.
She stays and drops plants in the nest.
p8.prompt: Close view of the Maiasaura mother's wide duck-like bill as she gently drops a pile of leafy green plants into the nest for her ten tiny babies, who crowd around to eat; Finn and Zeb watch from behind a fern, Finn sketching in his notebook.

text: One baby is out of the nest, in the rain.
What should they do?

reveal.text: Fossil hunters think Maiasaura mums looked after their babies for a long time. So the mum would come back. But a cold baby in the rain is hard to leave! Real explorers do not all agree. What do you think?

c2.prompt: Rain falls on a prehistoric plain. One tiny baby duck-billed dinosaur has wandered out of its mud nest and sits alone in a puddle, looking up; the mother dinosaur is a little way off with her back turned. Finn and Zeb crouch nearby under a big leaf, unsure what to do.

text: Finn lifts the baby. It wriggles!
He lays it back in the nest. Safe!
b2a.prompt: Finn carefully holds a wriggling tiny baby duck-billed dinosaur in both hands and lowers it back into the mud nest with its brothers and sisters, in light rain; Zeb watches with his hands clasped, delighted.

text: They wait by a rock. Rain drips off
their hats. Then the mum nudges it back.
b2b.prompt: Finn and Zeb sit patiently on a rock in the rain with water dripping off their hats, watching as the big Maiasaura mother gently nudges her tiny baby back into the nest with her bill.

text: They make a shelter from big leaves.
The baby stays dry. The mum takes it back.
b2c.prompt: Finn and Zeb hold up a shelter of huge green leaves over a tiny baby duck-billed dinosaur to keep it dry in the rain, while the big Maiasaura mother leans in to collect it; everyone smiling.

text: Finn makes a note: dino mums stay and
bring food to the nest. Case cracked!
p9.prompt: Finn sits on a log writing in his notebook, which shows a drawing of a mother dinosaur and a nest with a big tick; beside him Zeb holds up both thumbs. In the background the Maiasaura mother feeds her babies in the nest, sun breaking through the clouds.

text: The sun is low. The Time Gate will shut!
Zeb wants to see the babies play. Finn?
c3.prompt: Sunset on the prehistoric plain: far away the round time gate glows and flickers at the end of a trail; in the foreground Zeb kneels by the nest watching the baby dinosaurs play in the mud while Finn looks anxiously at a glowing dial on his wrist.

text: They race down the trail. Just in time!
The gate hums and takes them home.
b3a.prompt: Finn and Zeb sprint down a muddy trail towards the glowing round time gate as it flickers, Finn holding Zeb's hand, both grinning, ferns whipping past, sunset sky.

text: The babies play in the mud. Zeb laughs.
Then they run! They slide into the gate.
b3b.prompt: Zeb laughs as tiny baby duck-billed dinosaurs splash and tumble in a muddy puddle; then, in the same picture, Finn and Zeb slide feet-first through the mud into the glowing time gate just as it starts to close, sunset sky.

text: Back in the Den, Finn pins up the note.
Dino mums are great mums. Case cracked!
p10.prompt: Back in the cosy explorer den, Finn pins a drawing of a mother dinosaur with her babies onto a corkboard full of case notes, while Zeb hugs a toy dinosaur; the wall screen shows a big green tick.

casefile.title: Maiasaura
casefile.subtitle: The name means good mother lizard.

facts.text: Maiasaura means good mother lizard. The mums looked after their babies for a long time.
A grown-up was 9 metres long. That is as long as a bus.
Fossil hunters found 14 nests in one spot. The dinos nested together, like a big camp.

casefile.prompt: A Creature Cases style fact file portrait of a Maiasaura, a gentle duck-billed dinosaur, standing proudly beside her mud nest of tiny babies on a sunny prehistoric plain with ferns, a volcano far away; clean, bright, centred, like a collector card illustration, no text.

quiz.q: What did Finn and Zeb find in the mud?
quiz.why: A big footprint. Zeb could fit inside it.

quiz.q: What did the dino mum drop in the nest?
quiz.why: She brought plants for the babies to eat.

quiz.q: Why did Finn and Zeb go back in time?

options.text: To see if dino mums stay with their babies

quiz.why: Nobody could say, so they went to see.

quiz.q: Why is good mother lizard a good name for Maiasaura?

options.text: The mum stays and brings food

quiz.why: A good mum stays and brings food.

debrief.question: If you could go back in time, what would you want to see?
